events.headline: FY26 revenue crosses Rs 1,000 crore
events.description: NoBroker's FY26 revenue surpassed Rs 1,000 crore. Revenue grew from Rs 888Cr (FY24) to Rs 965Cr (FY25) to >Rs 1000Cr (FY26). Losses reduced 25-30% to ~Rs 300Cr. Targeting profitability in 8-10 months.

products.name: NoBroker (Buy/Sell/Rent)
products.description: Brokerage-free property search platform connecting owners with tenants/buyers directly. Core revenue vertical (~50% of revenue). Average resale ticket Rs 89Lakh, primary sale Rs 1.4Cr.

products.name: NoBroker Pay
products.description: Rent payment solution enabling credit card, debit card, UPI, and net banking payments for rent, maintenance, deposits, and token payments. Offers instant digital receipts for HRA tax exemption. Partnered with HDFC Bank PayZapp and SBI for cashback. Later extended to NBFC-partnered personal loans via Kisetsu Saison Finance (APR 10.99%-30%).
products.pricing_model: Transaction-based; credit card rent payments affected by RBI PA Master Directions Sept 2025
products.status: active (credit card rent payments status unclear post-RBI directive)

products.name: NoBrokerHood
products.description: Society management platform for gated communities and housing societies. Present in 11 cities serving 25,000 societies and 4.8M families. Includes grocery services launched during COVID-19.

products.name: NoBroker Homes (Packers & Movers, Home Interiors, Painting, Cleaning)
products.description: Packers and movers, home painting, cleaning, appliance repair, plumbing, electrical services. ~2 lakh service requests/month. Home interiors and moving services.

legal.description: RBI issued updated Master Directions for Payment Aggregators (PAs) and Payment Gateways (PGs) requiring PAs to aggregate funds only for merchants with contractual relationships. This directly affected credit-card-based rent payment category. Competitors (CRED, PhonePe, Paytm) suspended services within days. NoBroker Pay's compliance status remains unconfirmed in public record as of latest reporting (Feb 2026 blog content still describes credit card rent payment features as active).

NoBroker Pay partnered with RBI-authorized NBFC Kisetsu Saison Finance to offer personal loans through the platform. Disclosed APR ranging from 10.99% to 30% depending on repayment period and credit score.

customers.notes: PayZapp partnership for rent payment rewards
